title: Payment-History Reduction on the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Extension Fee
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — dollars taken off the extension fee for a sound payment record.**

**Rule.** When the contract shows at least 18 installments satisfied and no more than one late charge in the last 12 calendar months, 5.00 dollars are taken off the extension fee; when it shows at least 12 installments satisfied and no more than 2 late charges in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 2.50 dollars are taken off; in every other case nothing is taken off.

The dollars come off the extension fee as figured for the contract from the tier's extension fee, and the fee is never below zero.

| Installments satisfied | Late charges, last 12 calendar months | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 18 or more | none or one | 5.00 dollars |
| 18 or more | two | 2.50 dollars |
| 12 to 17 | none, one or two | 2.50 dollars |
| 12 or more | three or more | nothing |
| fewer than 12 | any | nothing |

**Records and counting.** Installments satisfied are the count on the contract record; late charges are the late charge entries on the contract's ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

*Hypothetical:* an extension fee figured at 22.00 dollars on a contract with 20 installments satisfied and one late charge in the window becomes 17.00 dollars; a fee figured at 4.00 dollars falls to zero, not below.
